decisions.reason: This black-finish range is very close to the firm's established drainage business and design capabilities, and with its own R&D and continued website prominence the firm can readily refine and support it commercially.
The seamless-covering shower channel fits the firm's core know-how in bathroom drainage and barrier-free architecture, so strong absorptive capacity and clear strategic fit make continuation likely.

Although this pump-drain shower channel builds on the firm's drainage expertise and R&D base, the more specialised pump-assisted concept and the earlier withdrawal of a related pump product make it somewhat more at risk than the other retained products.
